slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
A dilation with center O and scale factor k > 0 maps each point P to P' on ray OP with OP' = k times OP. The center maps to itself.

If k > 1 the image is an enlargement; if 0 < k < 1 it is a reduction; if k = 1 nothing moves. With the origin as center, (x, y) maps to (kx, ky).

To dilate a polygon by hand, draw a ray from O through each vertex and mark the image at k times the distance. A rubber-band pantograph does the same with k = 2.
